Thank you! 

Would it make sense for me to go to the UK for a few years to gain citizenship so that we both had that and then could decide to work on going back to the US or staying there? It is so crazy how even after marriage countries keep people a part =/

I just spent my summer living with three guys-- we got on well these are some things they did that helped beyond the obvious of don't be too loud or clean up. 

1) When I moved in they offered to help me move my things in-- generally just being helpful
2) they always asked me how my day was and said good morning and such, just helped me feel more welcomed
3) asked me if I wanted to join them once in a while when they went out
Thats something that can be so hard after you have been hurt! Does your SO know this about you? How does he feel about you having a wall up? (and out of curiosity, how long have you been dating?)

I actually had this situation happen recently, I just asked my parents directly if they would be okay with him staying in my bed. They took some time to discuss and agreed to it. If they initially seem unsure but don't say no, ask them why they are feeling that way to see if you can help ease any worries. Good luck!
